ATTACHED TABLE (related to Article 3)
Suppliers of Polyvinyl Chloride Paste Resin Originating from Germany, France, Norway, and Sweden Subject to Anti-Dumping Duties, and the Applicable Anti-Dumping Duty Rates

Country of Supply | Supplier | Anti-Dumping Duty Rate (%)
Germany | 1. Westlake Vinnolit GmbH & Co. KG and its affiliates | 31.55
Germany | 2. Other suppliers | 30.60
France | 3. KEM ONE and its affiliates | 31.55
France | 4. Other suppliers | 31.55
Norway | 5. Inovyn Europe Limited and its affiliates | 25.79
Norway | 6. Other suppliers | 25.79
Sweden | 7. Inovyn Trade Services SA and its affiliates | 28.15
Sweden | 8. Other suppliers | 28.15

Note: Where a supplier under subparagraph 2 has a special relationship with a supplier under subparagraph 1 pursuant to Article 23 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Customs Act, the anti-dumping duty rate applicable to the supplier having that special relationship shall apply notwithstanding the anti-dumping duty rate for the supplier under subparagraph 2.
